title: pvAMRDualClip
body:
## pvAMRDualClip

AMR Dual Clip (vtkPVAMRDualClip) clips non-overlapping AMR volume-fraction data with the dual grid and outputs, per selected material array, an unstructured grid of tetrahedra covering the region where the fraction exceeds VolumeFractionValue (multiplied by 255 internally). Level transitions are handled and interior tetrahedra can be decimated to keep the mesh small. Use it to get a volumetric mesh of a material region; use pvAMRContour for its surface only.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Volume fractions are expected as unsigned char 0-255 (as the Spy Plot reader produces by default); only unsigned char arrays are accepted here.
- The native class documentation states that it does not copy attributes yet; check which arrays the clipped mesh carries before relying on them.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `AMRDualClip`. Identity: `filters/AMRDualClip`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input of the filter. Accepted data: non-overlapping AMR data (vtkNonOverlappingAMR). The input needs at least one cell-centred array with 1 component. | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkNonOverlappingAMR"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `InternalDecimation` | If this property is on, internal tetrahedra are decimation | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `MergePoints` | Use more memory to merge points on the boundaries of blocks. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `MultiprocessCommunication` | If this property is off, each process executes independently. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `SelectMaterialArrays` | This property specifies the cell arrays from which the clip filter will compute clipped cells. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `VolumeFractionValue` | This property specifies the values at which to compute the isosurface. | `{"maximum":1.0,"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},

  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvAMRDualClip",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
